purpose: Fallback targets and layout limits per interface, used only where a board's own pair class does not say. Every number is a common design guideline with its basis; the board's acceptance (or the agent) overrides it. Edit freely.

usb3.basis: USB 3.x SuperSpeed: 90 ohm differential; few vias at 5-10 Gb/s

pcie.basis: PCIe: 85 ohm differential is the common design target (boards may choose 90-100)
